problem.title: Visual Studio Code doesn't find my python file. [Errno 2] No such file or directory
problem.description: I'm struggling with a Visual Studio Code python compiler. Whenever I try to run the code it says python: can't open file 'c:\Users\User\Desktop\Programowasko\Python\Cybepunk encounter calculator\cyberpunk.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory The only code which is written there is print("Hello World") by now. Also any other code which has recently worked, now it doesn't.
